notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone, i hope you are all doing well.
Here's what's new in this update:

- Leaderboard Rework: 
The leaderboard has been revamped to improve performance and tracking.
- Improved Spike Visibility: 
Spikes are now easier to spot, especially on darker backgrounds.
- Shorter Minigames: 
All minigames have had their durations reduced for a quicker, more intense experience.
- New Hard Mode: 
For a real challenge! You only get 1 life, the floor disappears faster, and obstacles spawn more frequently.

Jump back in and see if you can beat the new gamemode!
